records.text: Erika Kirk organized the Romanian Angels project, through which participants bought and wrapped wish-list gifts that were distributed to children.

appearances.snippet: Oh, and the Romanian angels? Yeah, that was a project that a bunch of us were blessed to be a part of because Erika (Erika Kirk) put it together and we would get a wish list around Christmas time and it was from children who wanted nothing more than barrettes. brushes personal care items pencils school supplies and we would all go out and go shopping and we would wrap it up and it was such a wonderful thing because we would have specific paper that we would wrap our gifts in and my daughters would then watch the video that Erika (Erika Kirk) would send back to us once the distribution and they were delivered and we could see the children opening these beautiful gifts

records.text: Tracy Martin told friends that her daughter was supposed to be at Utah Valley University on September 10 but that Tracy stopped her from going because she had a bad feeling.

appearances.snippet: Tracy (Tracy Martin) and her daughter told people that Tracy (Tracy Martin) had a bad feeling. Like I told you, we confirmed that. Tracy (Tracy Martin) had a bad feeling. And so she stopped her daughter from going to UVU. This is now confirmed. It's a fact.
Tracy (Tracy Martin) told friends that her daughter, ... was supposed to be at UVU on September 10th, but Tracy (Tracy Martin) had a bad feeling about it. ... Yep. And so she stopped her daughter.

verification.notes: Owens says she has private September 11 messages supporting this account, but those messages were not available for independent authentication.
